limitations: Instrumented C-O1 noGC standalone frozen BBC HTML, no scripts/resource replay/window/PNG. Layout then zero-size child insertion/reflow; only selected layout/update scopes enable profiling. Counts outside scopes are not measured. Native work is included in caller timings; inclusive times overlap and instrumented times are not instruction credit.

native_guard.metric: sampled sum of process-tree RSS; shared pages may be counted twice

compile_guard.metric: sampled sum of process-tree RSS; shared pages may be counted twice

interpretation: Call-pattern leads only. Instrumentation disproportionately charges tiny adapter calls; C-O1/noGC differs from production C-O3/bounded-prealloc. Recursive inclusive times overlap and cannot be summed. Production also keeps V development checks because prealloc browser uses C optimization without V-prod; this was separately checked in its frozen C source. No proposed guard removal or compiler-flag change.
